text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

WHEAT SALE - The CCC bought 56,229 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat under the export donation program to Ethiopia. The wheat was acquired from Farmland Industries Inc at $175.73 a tonne, FOB, out of Galveston, Texas for Nov 1-25 shipment.

SOYBEAN OIL SALE - Congo bought about 3,525 tonnes soybean oil under the PL 480 program for Nov 5-20 shipment, USDA said. The deal included 1,500 tonnes from ADM at $848.33 a tonne, free alongside (FAS) and 2,025.828 tonnes at $852.74 from ADM.

RICE SALE - Congo bought Thursday 13,389 tonnes U.S. long-grain milled rice, 20 percent broken, under PL-480 export program for Nov 5-20 shipment in a price range from $362.53 to $375.44 a tonne, free alongside (FAS).

CORN AND SOYBEAN TENDER - Taiwan will hold a tender for at least 72,000 tonnes of corn and 12,000 tonnes of soybeans from the United States, grain traders said. Taiwan Sugar Corp is expected to tender late next week for a combined shipment of 18,000 tonnes of No.2 U.S. corn and 12,000 tonnes of No.2 U.S. soybeans. Delivery is from Oct 25-Nov 10. Taiwan's FGEP group is also in for a 54,000 tonne corn for December delivery.

WHEAT TENDERS - Pakistan will tender for 200,000 tonnes U.S. grade 2 or better soft white wheat under the export credit guarantee program (GSM-102) for October 10-31 shipment, its U.S. export agent said. Bids must be received on September 29 and will remain valid until Sepember 30.

- Angola is seeking a maximum of 17,850 tonnes of U.S. No.2 or better hard red winter wheat in bulk under the PL 480, Title I, export donation program, its U.S. export agent said. The delivery period is set for October 10-25. Bids must be received by September 24 and remain valid until Sept 25.
WHEAT TENDERS - The CCC seeks up to 35,000 tonnes of U.S. No.2 or better soft red winter or soft white wheat for donation to Eritrea. Shipment is set for Oct 10-Nov 5. Offers are due by Sept 26.
- The CCC seeks up to 42,000 tonnes of U.S. No. 2 or better hard red winter wheat for donation to Georgia for Oct 10-Nov 5 shipment. Offers are due by September 23.

- Syria's General Establishment for Cereal Processing and Trade offered 100,000 tonnes of hard amber durum wheat for sale for November shipment. October 1 was final date for offers. Confirmation is set on October 2.
CORN TENDER - Jordan is to seek 50,000 tonnes of U.S. Number 3 yellow corn for shipment in first half of November. Offers must be received by September 25.

- The South African Maize Board was offering up to 33,000 tonnes of white corn for export in one unit of 20,000, 25,000 or 33,000 tonnes for shipment on October 23 to November 1, from Durban. The tender closes on September 25.
- CCC said it is seeking up to 16,000 tonnes U.S. No.2 or better yellow corn for donation to Rwanda. Shipment period is set for December 5-30 and offers are due by September 24.

RICE TENDER - Jordan postponed a tender for 15,000 tonnes of medium grain camolina rice to Sept 24, pinning hopes on reduced prices of Egyptian rice for November shipment. Offers must be received by Sept 24 in two 7,500 tonne lots.
BARLEY TENDER - Saudi Arabia will tender on September 20 to import a total of 1.72 million tonnes of optional-origin feed barley for delivery in October, November and December.

MARKET TALK - China postponed a visit planned for next week to discuss the TCK smut dispute that has effectively shut down U.S. wheat sales to Beijing, an Agriculture Department official said. Officials will try to set a new date.
... French farm minister Phillipe Vasseur said the European Union stood to lose its role as a key supplier of food to world markets unless it stepped up its farm exports.
... French wheat was firmer on Friday, helped by news EU reverted to granting wheat export subsidies for the first time in more than a year, dealers said.

... India signed contracts for 350,000 tonnes of soymeal exports for November-January shipments. Traders said demand for Indian soymeal from China and some other countries had increased due to its high 48 percent protein content compared to 44 in soymeal of other origins.
